description: lungmask R231 preprocessing + HierarchicalEncoder3D (Med3D-initialized, SE blocks) with 3 Softmax heads: high-recall binary screening triage (primary), 3-class fibrotic grouping (secondary), 5-class pathology mapping (tertiary). WebXR review is systems integration of existing standards, not a new XR method.
input_description: Single DICOM chest CT series (axial slices), 113-patient patient-disjoint 5-fold CV protocol (single-center MedGIFT; no external validation).

hierarchical_heads.binary: Normal vs Any-ILD high-recall screening triage (primary)
